units.source_text: 給你個忠告，傻瓜也會就此打住的。

en.t: Let me give you some advice: even a fool would stop right here.

units.source_text: 我今天還有別的事，最近忙得不可開交。」

en.t: I have other things to do today; lately I have been busy beyond belief.

units.source_text: 「小心點，你可別把坐墊的線給弄斷了。」

en.t: Careful. Do not go snapping the threads on the cushion.

units.source_text: 一邊無意識地用指尖扯動坐墊一角的細線，不知是縫線還是綁線。

en.t: I was unconsciously tugging with my fingertips at a thin thread on one corner of the cushion, whether it was stitching thread or tying cord I could not tell.

units.source_text: 堀木惜物心切，只要是家裡的東西，就算是坐墊上露出的一根線，

en.t: Horiki was fiercely protective of his belongings, and if something belonged to his house, even a single thread showing on a cushion,

units.source_text: 堀木都倍加愛惜，因此他橫眉豎眼地責備我。

en.t: Horiki cherished it all the more, so he glared at me angrily and scolded me.

units.source_text: 略微一想，堀木以前與我的交往中，從沒吃過一點虧。

en.t: Thinking about it a little, Horiki had never lost a thing in all his dealings with me.

units.source_text: 堀木的老母親端著托盤，送來了兩碗年糕紅豆湯。

en.t: Horiki's elderly mother came in carrying a tray with two bowls of sweet red bean soup with rice cakes.
